WITH device_page AS ( SELECT FROM ast_device d
LEFT JOIN ast_device_network_version nv ON nv.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND nv.device_sn = d.sn AND nv.deleted = b'0' AND nv.source_system = 'DEVICE_LOG' AND (nv.sync_status IS NULL OR nv.sync_status <> 'NOT_AVAILABLE') WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0'
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize} ), page_device_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sn FROM device_page ), renewal_counts AS ( SELECT wr.tenant_id, wr.device_sn, COUNT(*) AS extended_count FROM page_device_keys k JOIN ast_device_warranty_record wr ON wr.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND wr.device_sn = k.sn WHERE wr.deleted = b'0' AND wr.extended = b'1' GROUP BY wr.tenant_id, wr.device_sn ) SELECT p.*, COALESCE(rc.extended_count, 0) AS extended_count FROM device_page p LEFT JOIN renewal_counts rc ON rc.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND rc.device_sn = p.sn ORDER BY p.device_id DESC
